title: Chapter 491
paragraphs: Chapter 491
Episode 137: Everyone had good plans (2)
They decided to follow Joshua's group and slowly head towards the 2nd Tower.
In the next sectors, Zipple and Kinzello were slaughtering everyone, so there were no situations where they had to be caught in battle or hide.

There were scenes of dead bodies, blood, and destruction everywhere. From behind, the vibrations and noise of the ongoing battles continued, and it felt like the entire construction site would collapse soon.
It seems like it's our turn to be led by Joshua.
Diphus repeated Jin's last words while moving.
'Yes, even if he's the youngest, he can't understand everything perfectly.'
That fact was not disappointing at all.
'Joshua, that snake-like guy, is also skilled in strategy and has the power of a prophet... It's amazing that he has understood the flow so far. Honestly, I couldn't even catch up.'
Diphus felt pained by the fact that he still couldn't be of any help.

-Second brother, honestly, I didn't intend to make this suggestion to you. I thought I could kill Joshua by myself. But then, Sister Mary asked me. She wanted me to go with you and come back unharmed.
Jin's words before the operation began came to mind.
If they continued like this, even if they managed to assassinate Joshua, Jin would have to carry them. As fellow knights and as brothers, they couldn't accept that outcome.
'I have to be helpful. I must not create a situation where the youngest has no choice but to withdraw, like during the Barton incident.'
Just as Jin said he didn't know what Joshua's confidence was at the moment, Diphus couldn't come up with a solution right away.
However, it was important that he managed to regain his focus and determination, which had been momentarily lost in the excitement of being able to kill Joshua.
Diphus had rarely failed to do what he set his mind to.
Soon, the group crossed Sector 19 and reached Sector 20.
According to the construction site map, there was an emergency passage closest to the 2nd Tower here.
Looking around, they could see the traces of Joshua and the Black Knight forcibly opening the destroyed passage.
"Youngest, it seems there was no battle in the passage. Did Kinzello use another passage?"
"Or they could have used the high-ranking leader's gate."
"Damn, that ability they showed during the Imperial City Terror incident. All of them, except for Runcandel, are beyond the limits of the transportation gates."
"So far, Beimont hasn't shown any of those advanced technologies or powers."
"There's no comparison between the Empire and us. So, Beimont's guys are still invisible here. Anyway, it's irritating. Let's go."
Outside the passage was the Sota Desert.
Whoooosh-!
Fierce and dense sandstorms covered the entire desert. The huge sandstorms scattered here and there gave off an ominous feeling.

Of course, from here on, there were no traces of Joshua and the Black Knight. Footprints were immediately covered by the sand, and it was difficult to breathe without forming a protective shield with aura.
Environment.
Natural disasters or adverse conditions that were disastrous to ordinary people mostly didn't have a fatal impact on the well-trained warriors.
Even if they were struck by falling rocks, or even got hit by lightning with astronomical probability, warriors with 8-star ranking or higher did not die miserably.
Not to mention warriors like Jin and Diphus, who could be called superhumans.
The environment of the Sota Desert, which was threatening the party right now, far exceeded that ordinary level.
'It's no joke...'
It was a malicious environment where an ordinary person couldn't endure for even a single second. The wind laden with heavy sand slashed at the protective barrier like a knife.
The entire desert seemed to be boiling with terrible destructive magic.
That was indeed the case.
'These are large-scale barriers and cyclic defensive magic that are constantly maintained to protect the 2nd Tower.'
The 2nd Tower is one of Zipple's most important areas. It is located near the center of the Lutero Magic Federation, and next to it is their main base, Drakka.
It was natural to have such barriers and defensive magic at this level.
Diphus pointed outwards with his hand. The White Night Tower was visible in the hazy distance, obscured by the sandstorm.
The problem was that there wasn't just one tower.
"It's an illusionary barrier."
"Before you arrived, there were no observations of this phenomenon while I was constantly scouting."
"It's probably a barrier that only appears when you enter off the predetermined path or when you enter a certain area. Including the illusionary barrier and all other defensive magics."
There were a total of five towers.
Except for one, the rest were all fakes created by the illusionary barrier. And, as is often the case with such barriers, another trap would be activated when you reach the fake.
This time Murakan gestured toward the sky.
"Damn, I wondered why it was so dark... Kid, Diphus, look at those."
Flying ships filled the sky above.
At a glance, it seemed to easily exceed a hundred. If Jin, Murakan, and Diphus had any fear of Zipple in their hearts, they would have been scared stiff.
And unlike the towers, it was impossible to be sure that the flying ships covering the sky like a swarm of whales were illusions.
Considering the scale of the shipyard they had just confirmed, assuming there were a few more shipyards like that, it was a number that could exist in reality.
In other words, those ships could be mass-produced completed vessels that had come to support the shipyard.
"Shall I go to the sky first and clean up all of them? Also, check which of those towers is the real one."
"The moment you fly in your true form, we three are dead, Murakan. And at a glance, there are more than a hundred."

Even if the flying ships were illusions like the towers, flying in the middle of the Lutero Magic Federation would be a crazy thing to do. There would have been no need to plan an infiltration if it were such an easy problem.
"Ah, this is something that terrible species is good at."
"Misha?"
"Yes. I'm not good at discreetly disabling these kinds of barriers. I might be able to break them with force, but not like this."
Diphus spoke. Jin was thinking the same.

"I can roughly see why Joshua had that confidence. He must have had a way to avoid exposure to the barrier. Unlike me, he must have planned to rob the 2nd Tower instead of the shipyard from the moment he set up the camp, so he must have prepared the necessary means in advance. With the help of that so-called prophet."
"And he must not have thought that we couldn't break through this. Moving so blatantly as if to show off, probably meant that if we followed, he intended to use us."
Diphus continued.
As he said, Joshua had intended to 'actively utilize' Jin's party.
Since Jin's party and Kinzelo couldn't break through the barrier as fast as him who had the key, Joshua planned to naturally use them as bait after robbing the vault.
Even if he robbed the vault without a trace using the key, the fact that there was an intrusion and theft would eventually be revealed.
Of course, Zipple would have to track down the culprit.

To do so, they would need to completely disable the barriers around the 2nd Tower so that their allies could search easily, and at that time, Jin's party and Kinzelo, who were still struggling inside the barrier, would become the prime suspects and be pursued.
This development was also included in the picture that Joshua wanted.
Gritting his teeth, Diphus guessed the process faintly.
They couldn't let it go on like this.
"Lord Murakan."
"Yes."
"What if you move forward while blocking with your body? I will try to endure the traps in the front, and the youngest and Lord Murakan will chase after Joshua as quickly as possible."
"Really? Are you as sturdy as Runekandel's first or second daughter?"
"I'm at least close to that."
"Do you know how powerful the traps are?"

"It's just a moment when adventure is needed, as the youngest said last night. Didn't you say that even such a dangerous opportunity might never come again? We'll enter the 2nd Tower, get the real information, and kill Joshua."
"You're brave. I like that. Let's try to overcome this crisis with your sacrifice."
Murakan seemed to agree, and then glanced at Jin. As always, it meant that the decision was up to Jin.
Jin immediately refused, as if there was no need to even think about it.

"It won't work. That's our last resort. If Diphus gets caught in a trap, the loss of power will be too great, and if our position is exposed due to the activation of the barrier, there's really no solution."
"I thought you'd say that, youngest. Do you have any other ideas?"
Swoosh!
The spirit of Bradamante's sword emerged from its sheath.
"...I've experienced such a terrible desert once before. I obtained a sword along with the enlightenment back then, and I think it might work this time as well."
Spiritual Sword Technique 1: Soul Slash.
Jin had passed the final gate of the Mithra Desert using that sword. Even if Zipple's barriers and magic were great, they didn't seem to be superior to the Soldierlet's test.

After becoming allies with the Ghost Legion and the Blood Pact, the Soul Slash had worked effectively when the remnants of the former Ghost Legion, Seigalga, attempted a suicide attack in the nameless desert of the eastern Kascal Empire.
Huuu.
Bradamante's sword turned black.

"If the spiritual sword doesn't work, then I will try to personally unravel the barriers and magical spells using all my knowledge. If that doesn't work either, then we can consider putting Diphus in the front."
Jin closed his eyes and began to concentrate.

The determination to slash, the belief that it can be done, and the will to cut through and move on. The resolve and enlightenment gained in the Mithra Desert seemed to pierce his entire body and brain vividly.
Just before swinging the sword, a smile appeared on Jin's lips.
It was because an indescribable, strange feeling that seemed to have glimpsed the future and the outcome was spreading through the sword's tip.
The barrier and magic were cut apart by the softly swung sword.
Each time Jin swung the sword, the sandstorm subsided, and the illusions that were hiding the tower were washed away.
Jin continued to swing Bradamante until all of it was erased, looking as if he was performing a sword dance.
When he opened his eyes again, he felt refreshed as if he had taken a bath.
The terrible sandstorm and storm had disappeared as if they were lies. In the middle of the dark dawn with a gentle breeze, the lone White Night Tower was visible.
The White Night Tower was much closer than the illusion had hidden.
"The moment when my second brother has to risk his life for the family, it won't be just for breaking through such a barrier."
Jin said that and waited for Diphus' response, thinking that he had properly paid off his debt to him.
However, for some reason, no answer came even after a few seconds.
Instead, they heard Murakan clicking his tongue.
"Hmm... Well, those... were all real?"
Diphus couldn't respond for a moment, as he was taken aback by the fact that all the flying ships filling the sky were 'real.'
